name: Schemes Of H.P. Backward Classes Finance & Develpoment Corporation
targetBeneficiaries: notified backward classes living below the poverty line
briefDescription: This scheme by the H.P. Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation aims to uplift notified backward classes in Himachal Pradesh, focusing on social, educational, and economic development for those below the poverty line.
descriptionMd: The Schemes Of H.P. Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation are designed to facilitate the social, educational, and economic upliftment of communities. These initiatives specifically target notified backward classes within Himachal Pradesh. The primary goal is to empower individuals and families living below the poverty line, fostering overall development.
benefitsMd:
- Social upliftment
- Educational upliftment
- Economic upliftment
eligibilityMd:
- Applicants must belong to notified backward classes.
- Applicants must be living below the poverty line.
- Applicants must be residents of Himachal Pradesh.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
